standard.summary: Anima 首轮 VAE 缓存构建前对源图的缩放方式：longest（默认，最长边对齐目标）、shortest（最短边对齐）、freefit（自由适配多档位）。所有模式都保持宽高比。
standard.effect: 与 anima_cache_target_resolution 配合决定进缓存的图像尺寸：longest 保证整图不超目标（可能短边偏小）；shortest 保证短边达标（长边可能超出后再按桶处理）；freefit 为 within_epoch_free_fit 混合分辨率训练生成多档 latent。
standard.whenToUse: 常规训练用 longest；数据多为长条构图且想保住短边信息时用 shortest；要启用 epoch 内自由分辨率（mixed_resolution_strategy=within_epoch_free_fit）必须用 freefit。
standard.avoidWhen: 改动本键后旧缓存的几何语义已失效，需要重建缓存；freefit 缓存体积更大，不打算用 free-fit 训练就别选。

standard_en.summary: How source images are scaled before Anima builds its first-pass VAE cache: longest (the default, fit the longest edge to the target), shortest (fit the shortest edge), freefit (free adaptation across several buckets). Every mode keeps the aspect ratio.
standard_en.effect: Together with anima_cache_target_resolution it decides the image size that enters the cache: longest keeps the whole image within the target, so the short edge may end up small; shortest guarantees the short edge reaches the target and lets the long edge overshoot for later bucketing; freefit produces latents at several sizes for within_epoch_free_fit mixed-resolution training.
standard_en.whenToUse: Use longest for ordinary training; shortest when most of the data is elongated and you want to keep the short-edge information; freefit is mandatory to enable free resolution within an epoch (mixed_resolution_strategy=within_epoch_free_fit).
standard_en.avoidWhen: Changing this key invalidates the geometric meaning of an existing cache, so the cache has to be rebuilt. A freefit cache is larger, so do not pick it unless you intend to train with free-fit.

advanced.principle: 缓存训练把 VAE 编码前置，缩放策略在此刻固定了训练可见的图像几何。longest/shortest 是单档缩放的两种边界语义；freefit 按「恒定 token 预算」为同一图生成多个等效面积档位（等价方形换算），供 free-fit epoch 逐样本选档。
advanced.intervention: trainer_anima_cache_runtime.py：构建缓存时传 resize_mode 与 target_resolution（另有 anima_cache_resize_max_edge 在 shortest 模式下限制长边，0 时派生为 2×target）。
advanced.expectedImpact: 决定训练时的有效分辨率分布，从而影响细节水平与显存；freefit 模式解锁多分辨率训练能力。
advanced.tradeoffs: shortest 模式长边可能很大导致个别样本显存尖峰（用 max_edge 兜底）；缓存与训练配置强耦合，切模式需重建。

advanced_en.principle: Cached training fronts the VAE encode, so the resize policy fixes the image geometry training will see at that moment. longest/shortest are the two boundary semantics of single-profile scaling; freefit generates multiple equal-area profiles for the same image under a "constant token budget" (square-equivalent conversion) for the free-fit epoch to select per sample.
advanced_en.intervention: trainer_anima_cache_runtime.py: passes resize_mode and target_resolution when building the cache (anima_cache_resize_max_edge additionally caps the long edge in shortest mode, deriving 2×target when 0).
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Determines the effective resolution distribution during training, and thus detail level and VRAM; freefit unlocks multi-resolution training.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: In shortest mode the long edge can become very large, causing per-sample VRAM spikes (use max_edge as the guard); the cache is strongly coupled to training config — switching modes requires a rebuild.
